architecture.HEAD: 4231ae3daa812b38856c7c8c5cbaa99174408ace

summary.one_line: Generic companion packaging and right double click delivery preserve developer/player separation, per-mod packaging and existing callback lifetime ownership.

scope.reuse_verification: Compared git ls-tree entries at the previous attested commit and current HEAD for every prior cumulative path outside the subsequent delta; all71 match, including the retained deletion.

evidence: Read SDK AGENTS, README, CONTRIBUTING, commands pointer, configured architecture rules and the supplied canonical architecture role. Independently regenerated review:info and rechecked exact HEAD and clean worktree.
Read the previous architecture attestation actual PASS10 judgment and limits. Reused prior source/runtime/loader/lifecycle judgments only where Git equality was established.

resource_project is an explicit generic native-project declaration. Selection is parsed once from captured manifest bytes, constrained within the native source tree, and compared with the watcher first xalkit.json fingerprint before compilation. Initially absent declarations are also guarded.

resource_operation captures both artifact and build-report hashes while holding the existing resource lock. Companion publication requires both captured hashes, validates the matching artifact/report relationship, and rejects a foreign replacement even if it is another internally consistent build with the same resource ID.

Resource recipe and local files are snapshotted before building and compared after native compilation. Caches and native source trees are excluded from this local resource-input snapshot. The recorded build-report digest retains the existing builder template/game-input evidence without claiming that local source fingerprints alone capture all transitive provenance.

Native-only intermediates use a separate output directory when a companion is selected. The finished per-mod ZIP is replaced only after the combined temporary archive validates; failures preserve the previous final ZIP and do not emit a released event.

The combined archive contains one mod DLL and declared H5U, the two existing shared native dependencies, notices and player instructions. Validation requires exact members, checksums, permitted H5U paths, valid source/build fingerprints and existing PE export/import/deferred-import checks. No Python, Node, supervisor, source tree or workshop path is added as a player dependency.

Right double click extends the existing public WindowInputContext event whitelist. Bridge dispatch retains RuntimeLifetimeGuard, transition/reentrancy checks and a writable resident lease; runtime invocation retains its guard, EngineContextScope and PayloadDispatchScope. The event mod meaning remains in the payload callback.

The added native fixture exercises right double click through both HMR generations and checks borrowed context/dispatch-marker cleanup. It adds no predictor, bank rule, formula or renderer to the shared runtime or diagnostic bus.

All four current resource source/test SHA256 values match native-resources-independent-source-review-closed.json exactly. Its two earlier packaging/selection findings are closed, and their fixes were independently inspected in current code and regression scenarios.
The Game API gitlink equals reviewed API HEAD58f5ddc74d65b911e4a7e3f4e067c691f9425d5a. Existing loader, package templates and dependency policy remain Git-identical to prior accepted scope.

Read canonical architecture-contract lines17-85 in knowledge/docs/en/modding/native-projects.md. Current source ownership conforms to its responsibilities, dependency direction and cleanup rules; migration completion and ordinary final-package startup remain separate requirements.
